message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r3 -- no app start unless install and data clear both said Success; the standby holder's exit from its whole end

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_src_r2.md. Test-only; no product file.
N1: oa_avd.py starts the app only after `install` (rc 0 + Success) and `pm clear` of the test package (rc 0 +
stdout exactly Success, 60 s timeout) -- anything else is INVALID with no am start and no tap, and the clear is not
retried; arm P's post-start NO_CREDENTIAL check stays as a second line. oa_pmclear_test.py runs oa_avd.py itself
against a fake adb (stubs/fake_adb.cmd; OA_TEST_FAKE_ADB, refused together with an adb pin, cleared by oa_slot.ps1):
12/12; the 7714c85 oa_avd.py: 9 FAIL (the app started after a failed clear / install).
N2: remote60_ka_standby_holder_tool's exit (ka_standby_holder_verdict.hpp): Release not sent or the viewer not
ended within 15 s after it -> 5 (the job's end is cleanup only), the shared child verdict (children_end_all: end,
EOF, log) -> 6; ka_standby_holder_verdict_test 7/7; the fixture fails the bundle on a holder exit 5
(oa_orchestration_test 18/18).
